definitions.gloss: bundling; selling items together as a set; tie-in sale
definitions.explanation: Selling a desirable item only together with a less popular one, or combining products as a set. In commerce, {抱|だ}き{合|あ}わせ{販売|はんばい} (tie-in selling) is a way to move slow stock and is sometimes viewed negatively.

examples.japanese: ⟦{人気|にんき}{商品|しょうひん}→人気商品：21609_ninkishouhin⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{抱|だ}き{合|あ}わせ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{売|う}られていた→売る：00906_uru⟧。
examples.english: It was sold bundled with a popular product.

examples.japanese: ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦ソフト→ソフト：01532_sofuto⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{別|べつ}→別：01216_betsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦サービス→サービス：01531_saabisu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{抱|だ}き{合|あ}わせだ。
examples.english: That software comes bundled with another service.

examples.japanese: ⟦{売|う}れ{残|のこ}り→売れ残り：27773_urenokori⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{人気|にんき}{商品|しょうひん}→人気商品：21609_ninkishouhin⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{抱|だ}き{合|あ}わせ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{処分|しょぶん}→処分：05520_shobun⟧⟦しよう→する：00392_suru⟧とした。
examples.english: They tried to clear unsold stock by bundling it with a popular product.

notes:
From the verb {抱|だ}き{合|あ}わせる (to combine, make things go together). Most common in the phrase {抱|だ}き{合|あ}わせ⟦{販売|はんばい}→販売：03573_hanbai⟧ (tie-in sale).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {抱|だ}き{合|あ}わせ⟦{販売|はんばい}→販売：03573_hanbai⟧: tie-in sale; bundled selling
- {抱|だ}き{合|あ}わせ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{売|う}る→売る：00906_uru⟧: to sell as a bundle
- ⟦チケット→チケット：11014_chiketto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{抱|だ}き{合|あ}わせ: bundled tickets
